text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion dominates at the autumn Tenno Sho! As she runs, she's engulfed in thunderous applause and cheers of support…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ever-radiant during her run, the victory looks set to become one that will be spoken of for years to come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With this incredible race behind us, Fine Motion and I happily wonder what to do tomorrow. There are only a few months left before she goes back to Ireland… which means there's still time to enjoy Japan!
